full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff instituted the aforesaid suit against sole defendant-petitioner praying for decree with compensation for an amount of Taka 9,67,93,800. In the plaint it is stated that plaintiff entered into an agreement on 4-3-2003 with defendant No. 1 for construction of 6 storied building on the property of petitioner mentioned in schedule 'Ka' to the plaint with some other averments. Later on, agreement and power of attorney were cancelled by defendant No. 1 and RAJUK approved the cancellation of agreement and power of attorney on 17-11-2006 vide its letter No. RAJUK/Estate/5264 STHA and RAJUK had also approved the building plan on 28-3-2005.
